correctness.rationale: Deferred-decision independent-bond percolation represents each eventual infected component exactly, so expected infected from a uniform seed equals 1+S_v/r with S_v=sum over unordered connected-pair probabilities. For an r-cycle C_r=rΣ_(1≤j<r)q^j−binom(r,2)q^r, a residual path P_(r−1)=Σ_(1≤j≤r−2)(r−1−j)q^j, and one portal-root connectivity R_r=1+2Σ_(1≤j<r)q^j−(r−1)q^r. Hence S_h=2C_r and S_a=P_(r−1)+C_r+qR_r, giving D_r(q)=−q−Σ_(2≤j<r)(j−1)q^j+(binom(r,2)+2)q^r−(r−1)q^(r+1). Deleting a nonportal cycle vertex yields a residual graph isomorphic to deleting a portal plus an extra bridge edge, strictly increasing some pair connection for every q>0. D_r/q has sign changes −,+,− and hence at most two positive roots; D_r(0+) negative, D_r(1)=1, and D_r(∞)<0 show exactly one root in (0,1). D_r′(1)=r(r²−3r+8)/6 and D_r″=O(r⁴) imply D_r(1−c/r³)=1−c/6+O_c(1/r), proving the sharp scaling. Direct independent exhaustive bond-mask counts for r=3,4,5 and q∈{1/3,1/2,3/4,1} corroborated all candidate scores and strict inequalities (CASE4_OK). No heterogeneous transmission/other seeding result claimed.
residual_risks: The endpoint q=0 excluded: all vaccinations tie there.

evidence: Becchetti et al analyze independent-bond percolation for small-world random graphs and motivate SIR correspondence; the deterministic two-cycle network and single-vaccination optimum are not supplied in the inspected paper. Li–Zhao–Zhang publisher shows a site–bond vaccination model but full article is unavailable.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General epidemic-percolation equivalence is used, not new; it does not mechanically imply a particular all-r switch without computing pairwise connection sums. Full Li–Zhao–Zhang implications remain a priority risk.

originality.rationale: The standard Reed–Frost and independent-bond percolation coupling is prior (Becchetti et al. and Kenah–Robins). Li–Zhao–Zhang (2022) study vaccination and site-bond percolation in complex networks; only their full abstract/preview was accessible, so possible finite deterministic network optimization in the unread portions remains a documented risk. Chatterjee–Zehmakan uses a different degree-normalized epidemic law. None of the material actually read established the precise q_r switch, its uniqueness, or cubic approach. This is a best-of-knowledge priority judgment, not abstract-based full-paper noncoverage.
residual_risks: The plausible Li–Zhao–Zhang 2022 full primary article was inaccessible; exact double-cycle coverage in a hidden appendix cannot be ruled out from abstract alone.
Conclusions hold only for a single uniformly chosen unvaccinated seed, perfect single vaccine, independent homogeneous bond events on two equal cycles.
The endpoint q=0 excluded: all vaccinations tie there.

value.rationale: Network vertex vaccination optimization is a motivated graph-percolation statistic; the two-cycle-with-intermediary family makes a natural bridge-versus-portal choice where optimal strategy flips from degree-three portals to degree-two intermediary near q=1 with sharp r^-3 scaling. Exact all-r classification and a unique crossover are substantive rather than a tiny unmotivated graph computation. It does not claim empirical public-health strategy.
